methodology.label: IRC Media National Polls
methodology.disclosure: Polling reflects voter opinion during the dates surveyed. It is not a projection or election result.

sources.name: VoteHub Polling API
sources.note: Permitted national source, but disabled after the August 22, 2026 live compatibility and freshness check failed.

lastLiveValidation.reason: Live API response differed from documentation, contained incomplete records and had no polls newer than June 30, 2026.

sources.name: RealClearPolitics
sources.note: No official licensed API has been verified. Unofficial scraper packages are not approved.

sources.name: Original pollster releases
sources.note: Disabled until every proposed record has an original HTTPS release, complete methodology fields and editorial verification.

sources.name: Emerson College Polling
sources.note: Original pollster release used for attributed factual reporting; full methodology and results remain linked at the source.

sources.name: Rasmussen Reports
sources.note: Original daily presidential tracking release; reported as a five-day rolling average of 1,500 likely voters with direct methodology attribution.

monitoring.note: Daily checks produce a private workflow artifact. They do not modify polling.json or publish results.
